usage: agentbreeder services render [-h] [--cluster] --environment ENVIRONMENT
                                    --out OUT
                                    [--image NAME=IMAGE@sha256:DIGEST]
                                    [--env-file ENV_FILE] [--json]
                                    [dir]

positional arguments:
  dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cluster             Render for Kubernetes (the only target)
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --out OUT             A new directory, or one holding only a previous render
  --image NAME=IMAGE@sha256:DIGEST
                        The pushed image of a service built from a Dockerfile
                        (repeatable)
  --env-file ENV_FILE   KEY=value file; every value in it is scanned for in
                        the chart
  --json
